pages.text:
Each chassis has eight internal **control channels** carrying 0-15, like redstone. Modules read channels through **signal-in** bindings (enable, set, count...) and drive them through **signal-out** bindings (done, active, out...).

**Timing rule:** everything a module reads this tick was written last tick. When several modules drive one channel, the **highest** value wins, and a channel nobody drives reads 0. Loops therefore advance one step per tick and can never run away.

rows: AND, OR, XOR, NAND, NOR, XNOR, NOT, BUFFER

pages.text: **Hysteresis demo.** A Resource Sensor watches the RF buffer and enables the engine below 25% and stops it above 75%. Play it and watch the RF graph saw between the thresholds.
Logic modules use no RF, so a sensor can always switch on the generator that powers its own machine.
